margen.superficie: the unlit plaster wall of the bindery, its trowel marks still visible

escena: SCENE (paper selection, bindery in Lima, morning, NO faces): the hands work at a dark walnut worktop in the RIGHT half of the frame, lit by a hard shaft of window light that falls only on them and on the paper; the reserved plaster wall down the left side stays in its own unbroken shadow, with no beam, no furniture edge and no bright highlight inside it. A stack of ink-blue printed sheets sits under their fingers, caught AT THE INSTANT one sheet is pulled half out of the stack and bends under its own weight. 50mm at f/2.8. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the worktop immediately under the lens
